title: picklistmapping
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): columnmappingid, createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby.

createdon.description: Date and time when the list value mapping was created.

introducedversion.description: Version in which the component is introduced.

ismanaged.description: Information that specifies whether this component is managed.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the list value mapping was last modified.

picklistmappingid.description: Unique identifier of the picklist mapping.

picklistmappingidunique.description: Unique identifier of the Pick List Mapping.

processcode.description: Information about whether the list value mapping needs to be processed.

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the picklist mapping.

targetvalue.description: Microsoft Dynamics 365 list value with which to replace the source value.

_columnmappingid_value.description: Unique identifier of the column mapping with which this list value mapping is associated.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the list value mapping.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the picklistmapping.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the list value mapping.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the picklistmapping.
